# Apple

Get up to 6 months of No Cost EMI[\*](https://www.apple.com/in/#footnote-*) plus up to ₹15000 instant cashback[‡](https://www.apple.com/in/#footnote-%E2%80%A1) on selected products with eligible cards. [Shop](https://www.apple.com/in/shop/goto/store)

## iPhone

Meet the latest iPhone line-up.

[Learn more](https://www.apple.com/in/iphone/) [Shop iPhone](https://www.apple.com/in/shop/goto/buy_iphone)

![iPhone 17 Pro, back exterior, deep blue colour, Pro Fusion camera system in top left corner, Apple logo in centre, iPhone 17, back exterior, white colour, Dual Fusion camera system in top left corner, Apple logo in centre, iPhone 17e, back exterior, soft pink colour, Fusion camera system in top left cornre, Apple logo in centre, iPhone Air, side, titanium frame profile, Fusion camera system in top left corner](https://www.apple.com/v/home/images/iphone-family/a/hero_iphone_family__be5jkzxszb1e_large.jpg)

## College, sorted.

Get AirPods with Mac and Apple Pencil with iPad when you buy with education savings.Δ

[Shop](https://www.apple.com/in/shop/goto/edu_store)

![Students carrying various MacBook and iPad models, along with dorm room essentials in rectangular containers](https://www.apple.com/v/home/images/back-to-school-2026/a/hero_back_to_school_2026__cz07tzsg14sy_large.jpg)

Now supercharged by M5.

[Learn more](https://www.apple.com/in/macbook-air/) [Buy](https://www.apple.com/in/shop/goto/buy_mac/macbook_air)

![Two open MacBook Air laptops in sky blue color forming arrow shape, emphasizing narrow profile](https://www.apple.com/v/home/images/macbook-air-m5/a/hero_macbook_air_m5__eb1idggd120y_large.jpg)

Now supercharged by M4.

[Learn more](https://www.apple.com/in/ipad-air/) [Buy](https://www.apple.com/in/shop/goto/buy_ipad/ipad_air)

### MacBook Pro

Now with M5, M5 Pro and M5 Max.

[Learn more](https://www.apple.com/in/macbook-pro/) [Buy](https://www.apple.com/in/shop/goto/buy_mac/macbook_pro)

![MacBook Pro positioned into the shape of a V, referencing the M5 chip family](https://www.apple.com/v/home/images/macbook-pro/a/promo_macbook_pro__c9td9w1mc8ia_large.jpg)

The ultimate watch for a healthy life.

[Learn more](https://www.apple.com/in/apple-watch-series-11/) [Buy](https://www.apple.com/in/shop/goto/buy_watch/apple_watch_series_11)

![Apple Watch Series 11, rose gold colour, aluminium case, sleep score, right side exterior, Digital Crown, microphone, side button, starlight Sport Strap](https://www.apple.com/in/home/built/images/apple-watch-series-11/promo/promo_apple_watch_series_11__b63hxviqvonm_large.jpg)

### iPad Pro

Advanced AI performance and game-changing capabilities.

[Learn more](https://www.apple.com/in/ipad-pro/) [Buy](https://www.apple.com/in/shop/goto/ipad_pro/select)

![Two iPad Pro devices, front exterior, portrait orientation, black display bezel, display showing multicolored, curved line art, side exterior, thin profile, volume-up button, volume-down button, raised Pro Camera System](https://www.apple.com/v/home/images/ipad-pro/a/promo_ipad_pro__emtduc920o02_large.jpg)

### AirPods Pro 3

The world’s best in-ear Active Noise Cancellation.1

[Learn more](https://www.apple.com/in/airpods-pro/) [Buy](https://www.apple.com/in/shop/goto/buy_airpods/airpods_pro_3)
